messages:
Hannah (Finance): Quick note: new month-end invoice cutoff and virtual-card clarification effective Aug 1. Please read and adjust calendar-based renewals. Full doc: https://confluence.redwood/finance/invoice-cutoff-aug :loudspeaker:

Diego (Procurement): TL;DR:
- Invoice cutoff for month-end AP: invoices dated after the last business day will process next month.
- If you need payment in the current month, submit ticket and PO at least 48h before invoice date.
- Virtual-card preferred for one-off vendor payments <$2k; recurring SaaS should use PO/invoice.

Eli (Eng): If a vendor invoices on the 31st and we paid by v-card on the 1st (next day), will AP still count it in previous month spending?

Hannah (Finance): No, AP will count by invoice/charge date. To ensure previous month recognition, card charge must post on or before last business day and be tagged with PO number. Retro adjustments are rare and need FP&A approval.

Tara (Ops): On cross-border invoices: note added that FX timing can delay posting. Allow extra 2 business days and include bank wire proof if you need earlier recognition.

procurement-bot: Reminder: when creating a payment ticket include vendor_tax_form, bank_details (if wire), and PO number. Missing docs will auto-return the ticket. (Ref: AP-CUT-2026-08)
